summary.text: Arvind Venkat is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 30 who has served since December 1, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Arvind Venkat earned a bachelor's degree from Harvard University in 1996 and an M.D. from Yale University in 2000.
His career experience includes working as an emergency physician.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Venkat said he is a past president of the Pennsylvania College of Emergency Physicians and previously served on the board of the McCandless-Franklin Park Ambulance Authority.
He said that when elected in 2022 he became the first physician in the General Assembly in 60 years.

He listed protecting abortion rights, funding first responders and public schools, medical debt relief, affordable healthcare, gun safety legislation and preserving voting rights among his priorities.
Venkat assumed office on December 1, 2022, succeeding Lori Mizgorski.
In the 2023-2024 session he served on the Health, Insurance and Professional Licensure committees.
